context: This packet turns the approved self-assigning child plan into executable work with per-task `gate-reviewer` handoffs and per-wave review gates. The only wave change is inside the second wave: the bootstrap refactor must land before the child agent-id helper and subagent metadata work, because approved plan tasks 3 and 4 both depend on task 2.
